name: Continue with TOTP
description: Collects a one-time authenticator code for a known email identity and offers password fallback navigation.

web.implementation: Loads the primary login seed, submits the TOTP proof with generated AuthClient.createTotpLogin, follows the resolved success destination, and routes rejection to auth.continue.totp.unable.

mobile.implementation: Uses AuthContext.signInWithTotpAsync and generated AuthClient.createTotpToken for the token-backed TOTP sign-in path, then routes rejection to /auth/continue/totp/unable.

notes: The implementation field id totp is normalized to verification-code.
Validation copy is not used as a stable identifier.
Both supported clients consume generated AuthClient operations from nuviot/nuvos-app-contracts commit ad1e2ef725d9ca3865e4d889e877e4f3a723a2df.
